occupations.title: Customer Service Representatives
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: The excerpts describe a help desk software for a "support team" [D:Freshdesk:landing:3] to improve "service" [D:Freshdesk:landing:1], which is the primary function of customer service representatives.

tasks.text: Check to ensure that appropriate changes were made to resolve customers' problems.
Complete contract forms, prepare change of address records, or issue service discontinuance orders, using computers.
Confer with customers by telephone or in person to provide information about products or services, take or enter orders, cancel accounts, or obtain details of complaints.
Keep records of customer interactions or transactions, recording details of inquiries, complaints, or comments, as well as actions taken.

Oversee the daily performance of computer systems.
